competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove one beneficial effect granted on the target with a 75% chance and recovers the HP of the ally with the lowest HP ratio by 20%.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

effets.note: Recovers HP of the ally with lowest HP ratio

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects on the target ally and recovers both your HP and the target's HP by 25% each.
Removes all harmful effects granted on the ally. [Attack!] skill is randomly activated in proportion to the no. of harmful effects removed, up to 5 times.
